text.BHSA 1CH 3:5: וְאֵ֥לֶּה נוּלְּדוּ־לֹ֖ו בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑יִם שִׁ֠מְעָא וְשֹׁובָ֞ב וְנָתָ֤ן וּשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לְבַת־שׁ֖וּעַ בַּת־עַמִּיאֵֽל׃
text.KJV 1CH 3:5: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel:
text.KJV 1CH 3:6: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
text.KJV 1CH 3:7: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

A.name: Eliphelet

family: son-of david (David, son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3))

why: The Hebrew places Eliphelet after Ibhar and Elishama and before Nogah in David’s Jerusalem-born sons list. This matches A, the distinct son identified at 1 Chronicles 3:6 and also called Elpelet, rather than B.
